summary: Opened the auto-refresh picker on fwgr92-fc-n1 Bench Dashboard (it read "Off") and selected 1m; the control then displayed "1m". Entering edit mode and clicking Save dashboard showed "No changes to save" with Save disabled, so I ticked the drawer's "Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default" option (drawer went to tab "Changes 1", Save enabled) and clicked Save, getting a "Dashboard saved" confirmation. Persistence verified: after a fresh navigation to the bare URL /d/bg42gt535vc3kc/fwgr92-fc-n1-bench-dashboard, the auto-refresh control reads "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected" and displays "1m", with time range still Last 6 hours and both panels intact.
